units.source_text: 从停车场到这个温泉村，足有四里地。

en.t: From the parking area to this hot spring village was a full four li.

units.source_text: 因为阿笑乘的是七点的火车，公共汽车和马车已经没有其他乘客。

en.t: Because A Xiao had taken the seven o'clock train, there were no other passengers left on either the bus or the carriage.

units.source_text: 末班马车抵达时，长时间泡在温泉里、浑身都泡红了的村民正打着灯笼从山涧登上山来。

en.t: When the last carriage arrived, villagers whose whole bodies had turned red from soaking so long in the hot spring were climbing up from the mountain stream with lanterns in their hands.

units.source_text: 纵然是月夜，树荫却是黑沉沉的。

en.t: Even though it was a moonlit night, the shadows under the trees were pitch dark.

units.source_text: 沿街家家户户都关上门了。

en.t: Every house along the street had shut its doors.
